acceptance_criteria.criterion: WorkPackageDetailSchema includes last_updated: z.string().optional() and existing WP detail files without the field parse without error
last_updated is populated with now() on every WP detail write path (status transitions, claim, pipeline start/complete/cancel, WP creation, cascade reblock/unblock)
The staleness check in completePipeline() uses wp.last_updated directly instead of the composite proxy (status_changed_at + latest pipeline completed_at)
The staleness comparison in completePipeline() uses Date-based comparison (new Date().getTime()) instead of lexicographic string comparison
New schema test: last_updated parses when present, absent field still parses
New integration test: WP lifecycle (create -> claim -> pipeline -> complete) shows last_updated updated at each stage
New staleness test: Date-based comparison works correctly with edge-case timestamps

summary: Added last_updated: z.string().optional() to WorkPackageDetailSchema (backward-compatible)
Auto-stamp last_updated via now() in updateWorkPackageWithSync (covers all status transitions, claim, pipeline start/complete/cancel)
Set last_updated in createWorkPackage initial construction
Set last_updated in propagateDependencyUnblock and propagateDependencyReblock (cascade operations)
Simplified staleness check in completePipeline to use wp.last_updated directly instead of composite proxy (status_changed_at + pipeline completed_at)
Switched staleness comparison from lexicographic string to Date-based (new Date().getTime())
Added 2 schema tests (last_updated present and absent), 1 lifecycle integration test, 1 Date-based staleness edge-case test
Updated 4 existing staleness test fixtures to include last_updated field

comments.note: The updateWorkPackageWithSync method in ledger-store.ts is the ideal choke point for auto-stamping last_updated since it covers all atomic WP+root writes. However, createWorkPackage and propagateDependency* use writeWorkPackage directly, so last_updated is set explicitly there too. A future consolidation could route all writes through updateWorkPackageWithSync to eliminate the duplication.
